title: Fooling the Mind Twice: Human Detection of Audiovisual Deepfakes Under Repeated Exposure and Corrective Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.27080v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human deepfake detection remains unreliable, and whether reassessment with corrective feedback improves subsequent judgments remains unclear. This study examined differences between initial and repeated deepfake assessments among 110 participants using audiovisual stimuli from the FakeAVCeleb and Deepfake Detection Challenge (DFDC) datasets. Participants evaluated 40 videos from each dataset in phase 1 (PhaseI) and reassessed the same videos in phase 2 (PhaseII) under a procedure combining repeated presentation and corrective feedback. For the FakeAVCeleb dataset, the participants' mean accuracy increased by 4.68 percentage points from 63.30 in PhaseI to 67.98 in PhaseII (t(109)=5.61, p<.001, d_z=0.54). A judgment-level logistic regression with standard errors clustered by participant and video produced a consistent result: beta=0.208, SE=0.040, z=5.23, p<.001, {OR}=1.23. For the DFDC dataset, the participants' mean accuracy increased

translated_title: 双重愚弄心智：重复暴露与纠正反馈下人类对视听深度伪造的检测
translated_abstract: 人类对深度伪造内容的检测仍然不可靠，而在纠正反馈辅助下进行重新评估能否改善后续判断尚不明确。本研究使用来自FakeAVCeleb和深度伪造检测挑战赛（DFDC）数据集的视听刺激材料，考察了110名参与者在初次评估与重复评估深度伪造内容之间的差异。参与者在第一阶段（PhaseI）对每个数据集中的40个视频进行评估，并在第二阶段（PhaseII）在结合重复呈现与纠正反馈的流程下重新评估相同的视频。在FakeAVCeleb数据集上，参与者的平均准确率从第一阶段的63.30%提升至第二阶段的67.98%，提高了4.68个百分点（t(109)=5.61, p<.001, d_z=0.54）。以参与者和视频进行标准误聚类的判断层面逻辑回归得到了一致结果：beta=0.208, SE=0.040, z=5.23, p<.001, OR=1.23。在DFDC数据集上，参与者的平均准确率也有所提升（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 研究发现，重复暴露并结合纠正反馈能显著提高人类对视听深度伪造视频的检测准确率（FakeAVCeleb数据集上平均提升4.68个百分点），表明纠正反馈是改善人类深度伪造识别判断的有效手段。
